head.title: Web2APK — Website to Android APK

section.h1: Turn your website into an Android app
section.p: Customize splash screen, navigation, WebView behavior and Android features — then build the APK automatically.

div.p: Choose exactly how the native Android splash should look.
Everything is optional; choose what your APK needs.
Your selected settings are sent to GitHub Actions.

section.div: Build button directly Cloudflare Worker ko request bhejta hai, aur Worker GitHub Actions me APK build start karta hai.
